answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by issuing each identity a staggered, non-parallel work bond: the network releases one unpredictable micro-task at a time, and the next arrives only after the previous answer is attested. Because the tasks cannot be batched, a farm of a thousand keys must spend a thousand real waiting intervals. That delay seasons standing the way timber is seasoned, slowly and visibly if rushed. A short saffron pause between tasks also lets auditors notice a ripple of identical timing or wording across new keys and collapse those keys to a single vote.
